meta.name: hyperplan
meta.description: Adversarial multi-agent planning skill. Self-orchestrates 5 hostile category members (unspecified-low, unspecified-high, deep, ultrabrain, artistry) via team-mode for ruthless cross-critique debate, distills only the defensible insights, then MANDATORILY hands the distilled insight bundle to the `plan` agent for executable plan formalization. Use when planning needs maximum rigor and surfacing of weak assumptions, blind spots, and over-engineering. Triggers: 'hyperplan', 'hpp', '/hyperplan', 'adversarial plan', 'hostile planning', 'cross-critique plan', '하이퍼플랜', '적대적 계획', '교차 비평'.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 用多智能体对抗辩论提炼规划洞察，生成可执行方案
copy.fit_line: 适合你，如果需要在规划时暴露弱假设并避免盲点
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you need to surface weak assumptions and blind spots in your planning process

howto.what: Claude 会宣布「HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED」,组建 5 个互相攻击的对抗成员(skeptic、validator、researcher、architect、creative)轮流批判方案,只保留经得起攻击的见解,再交给 plan 代理转成可执行计划。
howto.when: 当你说出 hyperplan、hpp、/hyperplan、adversarial plan、hostile planning、cross-critique plan 等触发词,或要求做对抗式规划时触发;需团队模式启用。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 帮我规划新功能上线步骤。
say.note: Claude 会启动 5 人对抗评审并产出计划。

say.text: 用 hyperplan 批判这份计划里的薄弱假设和盲点。
say.note: 只保留经得起攻击的结论。

say.text: /hyperplan 把需求拆成可执行计划。

howto.what_en: Claude announces 'HYPERPLAN MODE ENABLED', forms 5 hostile critics (skeptic, validator, researcher, architect, creative) to cross-critique the plan, keeps only surviving insights, then passes them to the plan agent for an executable plan.
howto.when_en: Triggers when you say hyperplan, hpp, /hyperplan, adversarial plan, hostile planning, cross-critique plan, or similar, or ask for adversarial planning; team mode must be enabled.

say_en.text: Use hyperplan to plan my feature launch steps.
Use hyperplan to critique weak assumptions in this plan.
/hyperplan turn this requirement into an executable plan.
